pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/sceneModel.ts:250 The stage kit's only 'memory' is ChatMemory, a capped cache of chat lines kept for the screen. It forgets the oldest lines that nothing on screen pins, and no model ever reads it. A search of packages/stage-kit for recall, belief, embedding, consolidat and episod found nothing, so the subject's pipeline of capture, distill and recall into an agent's context is absent here.

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-clips/src/lib.rs:8 The clip factory scores a finished transcript with a single stateless model call per run, plus signals that are measured mechanically. It keeps no agent memory: its store holds clip drafts and owner verdicts, not things an agent recalls. A search of crates/shadowrunr-clips and the daemon clips glue for belief, embedding and consolidat found nothing, and the clips crate has no memory or recall hits either.
